title: HiringRecommendation
description: The governed, explainable output of the Decision Authority under a specific Hiring Decision Contract version (projected from a signed IR digest). Advisory: it proposes but does not bind. Its inputs are exactly (dimension evidence, mandatory gates, confidence, contract) — the Overall Fit Index NEVER enters the Decision Authority and does NOT appear on this object; it lives only in the Analytics plane. NOT_ELIGIBLE is forced whenever eligibility != ELIGIBLE, regardless of fit. Contains everything needed to reconstruct the reasoning; never a black-box ranking.

compiled_from_ir_digest.description: Content address of the signed HiringWorkflowIR the contract projects. Reproducible provenance.

evidence_lineage.description: Lineage node ids backing every claim in this recommendation.

proposed_action.description: The action the recommendation proposes, constrained to the contract's action_constraints. Checked by the Hiring ActionGate before any HRIS/ATS write. Present only when recommendation == ADVANCE.

recommendation.description: Advisory. Forced to NOT_ELIGIBLE when eligibility != ELIGIBLE. ADVANCE/HOLD/DECLINE only proposed among eligible candidates.

reason_tree.description: Structured, human-readable reasons linking eligibility, gates, and dimensions to the recommendation.

basis.description: Lineage node ids / gate ids / dimension ids.

approval_chain.description: Human approver roles required to bind (from the HDC).

actor_type.description: A recommendation is authored by the AI/Decision-Authority pipeline; it is never a binding decision.

binding.description: A recommendation is always advisory here. It becomes binding only when the external shared Decision Authority adjudicates it (DecisionAuthorityPort), which yields a separate HUMAN-authored BindingDecision — never a mutation of this object.
